items.title: KKR earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- KKR & Co LP (KKR) reported Q3 2026 on Nov 9, 2026 (pre-market). Adjusted net income per share was $1.78 against a $1.59 estimate (+11.95%). Revenue was $4.56B against $2.69B expected, though the revenue comparison is distorted by how the firm books performance income. The stock was at $98.65 (+2.25%) as of 3:04 PM EST. That is still -23.46% YTD and well below its 52-week high of $144.84.
